GUILD.//: Battle Re-work Part 9 (2026-10-16): the Guild hall in the Village (in the estate's old spot, Cam's Q2). The Guildmaster leads the tour (Q2: Amunet hands you over); each class has a stand-in here for its real tutor (who lives out in the world), who explains the class, swears it's the best (Cam: 'some smug talk as to why it is the best class. A natural banter between them'), teaches its trick with a quest, and takes the price of switching to it. switch: coins and items to become this class; back: the share you pay to go back to a class you've played (Q7: 50%).

guildmaster.name: Guildmaster Orla
guildmaster.says: Welcome to the Guild. Every one of them will tell you their way is the only way. Every one of them is half right.

tour.name: Meet the Guild
tour.text: "Amunet sent word you'd be along. Before you pick a road, walk the hall -- talk to each of them. Then choose; choosing again later costs, and they all know it."

hunter.title: for Ranger Ash
hunter.intro: Ash sends his regards, and says not to touch his snares. The Hunter's road is patience: a bow, a knife for when the arrows run out, and a trap for anything that thinks it's quicker than you.
hunter.smug: Everyone else fights what's in front of them. We decide what's in front of us.
banter: Thorvald's lot charge in and call it courage. We call it lunch arriving early.
Nell says she's quieter than me. She isn't. I can hear her coins.
The Arcane need a rune for every spell. I need a stick and some twine.

quest.name: Ash's lesson
quest.text: "Ash's own lesson is out in the Forest -- go and see him. Me, I just want to see you catch 15 things in a trap or a net."

berserker.title: for Old Thorvald
berserker.real: Old Thorvald, in Frosthaven on Frostpeak
berserker.intro: Thorvald's in the north with the cold and the yaks. I'm here with you. The Berserker's road is simple: hit it, get hit, get angrier -- and spend the fury on one blow it never forgets.
berserker.smug: The others count their arrows and their runes. I count the bodies.
banter: Wren likes traps. A trap is a coward's handshake.
Sister Maren's lot block. Blocking is just waiting to hit something.
I asked the Arcane apprentice to set my maul on fire. She said no. Twice.

quest.name: Red mist
quest.text: "Thorvald's first lesson: let it fill. Fill your fury to the top, once, in a single hunt -- then we'll talk."

arcane.title: the Archmage's apprentice
arcane.intro: The Archmage is busy, which is why you have me. The Arcane road: four elements, a wand or a staff, and the patience to read before you swing. Fire burns, water slows, earth breaks, air topples. Learn which one the creature fears.
arcane.smug: They all need to be standing next to the thing. I don't.
banter: Brakka asked me to enchant his maul. I enchanted his breakfast. He didn't notice.
Wren's arrows are just very small spells with feathers.
Nell's poisons are clever. Mine are faster.

quest.name: The four elements
quest.text: "Show me you can read a creature: land ten of your spells' element effects -- a burn, a slow, a broken guard, a stagger."

thief.title: for Nell the Fence
thief.real: Nell the Fence, in the smugglers' cove on the Coast
thief.intro: Nell doesn't come to town. Too many people who'd recognise her. The Thief's road: two daggers or a bow, a little something on the blade, and never being where the blow lands.
thief.smug: The best fight is the one that's over before they know it started.
banter: Brakka says counting is for cowards. Brakka can't count.
Sister Maren prays for my soul. I've taken her purse twice. She hasn't noticed either time.
Ilse's spells are lovely. They cost runes. My poison costs mushrooms.

quest.name: Steal back the ledger
quest.text: "Nell's ledger went missing with some very angry people. Prove you can go where they swing and not be there: dodge ten blows."

paladin.title: for Sister Maren
paladin.real: Sister Maren, at the Village chapel
paladin.intro: Sister Maren keeps the chapel; I keep the door. The Paladin's road: a sword, a shield, and devotion -- it grows each time you stand your ground, and it heals.
paladin.smug: Anyone can win a fight. We're the ones still standing at the end of the week.
banter: Pip took my purse again. I let him. He needs it more, and he's terrible at it.
Brakka calls blocking 'waiting'. Brakka also calls bandages 'losing'.
Wren's traps are honest work. Smelly, but honest.

quest.name: Hold the bridge
quest.text: "Maren's first lesson: hold. Block five blows with your shield."

beastmaster.title: for Warden Briar
beastmaster.intro: Briar won't come indoors -- says the hall smells of people. So you get me. The Beast Master's road: you don't swing a sword, your pets do. You choose their moves, feed them, swap them out, and you never take a blow yourself.
beastmaster.smug: Every other road in this hall ends with you bleeding. Ours ends with you holding the lead.
banter: Wren calls my pets 'walking traps'. Wren's traps don't come when they're called.
Brakka tried to arm-wrestle my bear. Once.
Ilse wants to know what a spirit owl is made of. So do I. I'm not asking it.

quest.name: Run with the pack
quest.text: "Briar's first lesson: trust them. Win ten fights with your pack."

books.//: A book per class (Cam's proposal, V1 carried 10-1): bought at the Guild hall, read from the bag anywhere -- everything about the class, made from the game's own data (it can't drift).

builds.//: Two builds per class for its book (the Combat Designer: 'build guides ... have nowhere to live today').
hunter: Trapper first (Snarecraft, Barbed jaws, Ambush), then Wilds' Light step and Hardy: traps that open every fight and hurt, and a body that lasts. For bosses and hard ground.
Marksman to Killing shot, then Wilds' Quiver craft: the most damage from a bow, fewer arrows used. For fast hunting.
berserker: Slaughter to Opening blow, then Bloodrage's Seething and Bloodthirst: damage, and fury that turns into more of it.
Juggernaut to its keystone, then Bloodrage's Second wind: hard to kill, Bloodlust to heal. For long hunts with little food.
arcane: Elements to Avatar, then Arcana's Fourth sigil: four spells, and every element effect landing harder.
Battlemage first, a battle staff in hand: armour while casting, a real blow when the runes run out.
thief: Venom to Black blood (Virulence for three poisons), then Shadows' Nimble: poison doing the work while you stay out of reach.
Blades to Thousand cuts with two daggers, then Shadows' Ambusher: the most blows a round.
paladin: Crusade to Avenger, two swords or a sword and shield: the Paladin's damage.
Bulwark to Bastion, then Grace's Devout: blocks, bashes and devotion -- the safest hunter in the game.
beastmaster: Bond to Pack leader: three pets in every fight, each hitting harder. Train them up in the Pen.
Keeper to Beast whisperer, then Wild's Quick learner: pets that train themselves to level 40 and rest quickly -- the patient way.

TECHNIQUES.//: Techniques (Cam: 'once a thief unlocks the ability to make poison he shouldn't lose it when changing class'): two per class, learned for good by putting a point in its node; slots (more at New Game Plus 1 and 3); off your own class they work at offClass strength. fx: what it adds (the same keys as talents).

trapmaking.name: Trap-making
trapmaking.about: Lay a Hunter's snares and throw its nets, whatever your class.

fielddressing.name: Field dressing
fielddressing.about: Now and then an extra hide or piece of meat from a kill.

secondwind.name: Second wind
secondwind.about: Once a fight, at a fifth of your health, a tenth of it back.

runesaving.name: Rune-saving
runesaving.about: Now and then a spell costs no runes.

poisoncraft.name: Poison-crafting and coating
poisoncraft.about: Coat any weapon with a poison or venom.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocketing
pickpocket.about: +10% coins from kills -- and you can steal and pick pockets in the Marketplace, whatever your class.

shieldtraining.name: Shield training
shieldtraining.about: Carry a wooden buckler in your off hand, whatever your class.

animalhandling.name: Animal handling
animalhandling.about: Your companion's help in a fight: +1 max hit.

tending.name: Tending
tending.about: Food and potions heal your pets 10% more.

TALENT_LABELS.//: What each talent effect is called in a class book (V1: the book's numbers are the game's own).
TALENT_LABELS.dressChance: chance of an extra hide or meat
TALENT_LABELS.elemDmg: damage to a creature under your element
TALENT_LABELS.elemWeakDmg: damage when it's weak to the element
TALENT_LABELS.layFree: Lay on hands keeps your turn
TALENT_LABELS.poisonStun: stun chance on a poisoned creature
TALENT_LABELS.saveOnce: one deadly blow blocked a fight
TALENT_LABELS.trapUse: use a Hunter's traps and nets
